comment: The panel letters the main audio jacks CV IN and CV OUT, while the maker's own tooltips call both of them Audio and Korupt.cpp:151 writes an audio mix there; the lines follow the code and name the conflict. The lock output is a continuous confidence figure rather than a gate (korupt-dsp.h:404-415), so it is coloured cv. The oscillator's own range is 18Hz to the lesser of 9800Hz and 36% of the sample rate (korupt-dsp.h:353-358), which caps how high the chosen interval can actually reach.
